Kyle.fact: A woman stands motionless in the rain for eleven minutes, covertly watching Kyle.
The woman steps under the awning and gives Kyle a precise, minimal gesture to follow.
Kyle sets down his chopsticks and chooses to follow the woman into the rain.
Kyle leaves Φ40 on the counter — twelve over the cost — and Mrs. Chen covers the bills without looking.
Kyle follows the woman into the dark of the walkway, falling in six feet behind her.
Kyle observes that the woman has not adjusted her stride for puddles, concluding she has extensively prepared and rehearsed this route.
Kyle notices the woman's coat has not soaked through after eleven minutes in the rain, revealing it is expensive and purpose-built.
Kyle chooses to step through the held door into the relay station, recognizing the woman needs him to enter willingly.
Once inside the relay station with the door closed, the low electromagnetic hum Kyle had never consciously noticed in his implant goes completely silent.
Kyle discovers that the internal hum he had attributed to his implants for eleven years is actually an external entity monitoring or influencing him through his neural hardware.
Sable removes her hood, revealing her face to Kyle for the first time after two months of audio-only contact.
Sable explains she deliberately concealed her identity so Kyle would follow a stranger, preventing the entity monitoring him from recognizing their meeting.
Kyle agrees to help Sable locate the entity by continuing to behave exactly as normal, knowing this is not a neutral act.
Kyle and Sable enter the wet market together.
Kyle's NeoCortex detects a familiar unannounced signal or presence — 'the hum' — registering it like a footstep behind him.
Kyle and Sable walk through the conflict without altering their stride or intervening.
Kyle acknowledges that whatever Sable's node is reading is connected to something that has been living in his chest for eleven years.
Kyle and Sable enter a Tier 1 residential block from the market district.
Kyle's NeoCortex registers the shift to lower signal density as they enter the residential block.
Kyle consciously files the intimate gesture between the couple himself, distinct from his NeoCortex, and recognizes the significance of that difference.
Sable resumes walking at the same pace and says nothing to Kyle about what she discovered in the node.
She tells Kyle she will contact him when timing is operational, asserting they go together on her read and her call.
She says 'Thank you,' signaling that an agreement has been finalized and is now irrevocable.
Kyle turns north and begins walking toward The Pivot after watching her go for three seconds.
As Kyle passes the last planter, the hum returns to his sternum, settling with the quality of something returning to its place.
